prompt: The compilation succeeds but the program crashes with StackOverflowError. Why?
choices: The compiler didn't detect infinite recursion
fib(n) has no base case — it recurses infinitely, filling the call stack
Integer arithmetic overflows in the recursion
The JVM cannot handle recursive methods
explanation: Syntax is valid so it compiles. At runtime, fib(10) calls fib(9) and fib(8), which call fib(8) and fib(7) and fib(7) and fib(6)... with no base case to stop. Fix: add if (n <= 1) return n; as the base case.
